name: The Gordunni Orb
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Although I know my enemy well, I am a warrior, adventurer. I cannot begin to tell you what this orb is capable of.

I know of a mage in Orgrimmar that will be able to tell us more about the orb. Take it to him.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Fascinating, adventurer...

This orb is very powerful, but also very dangerous.
narrative.requestItemsText: What have you brought me, friend?
